_about: Round 141c. A mini-game for each craft (scripts/systems/CraftPlay.gd): optional, bounded and the same for everyone. 'bonus' is the most a game can move the odds: chance_hi = +12 points of success for a flawless game, chance_lo = -4 for a rough one, quality_* the same on the quality roll (lower rolls are better), xp_hi = up to +30% skill xp. Games per craft, and each game's feel.
